messages:
Maria G: quick QA — I opened a tiny Terraform change to create an IAM role for the metrics-uploader service account in namespace `metrics`. Wanted a sanity check on the assume_role_policy + the k8s annotation wiring before I merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/452

Alex K: can you paste the SA yaml + the tf assume_role_policy here? :eyes:

Maria G: sure — here's what I put in the k8s manifest and TF (trimmed):
```yaml
# k8s service account
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: metrics-uploader
  namespace: metrics
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/metrics-uploader-role
```
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "metrics_uploader" {
  name = "metrics-uploader-role"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [{
      Effect = "Allow"
      Principal = { Federated = aws_iam_openid_connect_provider.oidc.arn }
      Action = "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity"
      Condition = {
        StringEquals = {
          "${replace(aws_iam_openid_connect_provider.oidc.url, \"https://\", \"\")}:sub" = "system:serviceaccount:metrics:metrics-uploader"
        }
      }
    }]
  })
}
```

Jonah P: couple things to tighten up:
- include the audience check (sts:aud = "sts.amazonaws.com") in the Condition (some OIDC providers put different aud).
- avoid using a replace() expression that might accidentally produce the wrong claim key; better to reference the provider url variable explicitly if possible.
- make sure the sub is exact (StringEquals) not a wildcard StringLike unless you intentionally want multi-sa access.

Sasha T: also note: if this role could be reused by other namespaces (e.g., infra devs reusing same role), you might want to embed namespace/name in the role name and the trust policy to be paranoid. If cross-namespace use is expected, add an approval in the PR.

Maria G: good calls. I'll add the sts:aud check and change the Condition to be explicit equality for the sub. I'll also rename the role to include `metrics` so it's obvious. Will rerun terraform plan + policy-lint. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: policy-lint/job/782 failed on PR 452 — error: assume_role_policy missing required `sts:aud` StringEquals rule. See CI: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/782/logs

Alex K: cool — once lint is green I'll do a quick review. thanks for the ping! :+1:

Maria G: thanks all, updating now.
